title: Panforte-Glazed Sardinian Sausage Stir Fry
description: A fusion twist on traditional Chinese stir-fry with the addition of Panforte-glazed Sardinian sausage and crispy rocket. This sweet and savory dish is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Marinate the Sardinian sausage in soy sauce for at least 10 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the marinated sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced Panforte and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the chopped rocket and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for another minute.
Drizzle honey over the top and toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
